summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 new Combined Site Plan / Worksheet enhancements on lead d0df5baa. All 4 features pass, plus regressions.

verified_features.refine_hint_badge: PASS — badge shown only on structure-row-1 'Attached Garage' (structure-inferred-badge-1). House (row-0) and Front Covered Porch (row-2) correctly have NO badge.
verified_features.snap_to_wall_drag: PASS — while dragging site-plan-structure toward a neighbour, a blue dashed line with data-testid=site-plan-snap-guide appears; it is removed after pointer-up. No console errors.
verified_features.title_block_and_multipage_pdf: PASS — site-plan-export-pdf triggers download of 'site-plan.pdf' (21.4 MB, 4 pages). Text markers present in PDF bytes: 'Combined Site Plan', 'Prepared by', 'Date:', per-structure page marker 'roof sketch', plus 'House', 'Attached Garage', 'Porch'. Page count = 1 combined + 3 per-structure = 4, matching expectation.
verified_features.regressions: PASS — PNG export downloads site-plan.png; north (site-plan-north) and scalebar (site-plan-scalebar) render; 3 site-plan-dim tags render; combined plan shows 3 structures; combined-site-plan-reset visible/clickable.

critical_code_review_comments: CombinedSitePlan.jsx: exportPdf references view.barFt inside the title-block line even when view could theoretically be null; guarded by the early-return so safe currently, but could break if refactored.
The rasterized combined plan is embedded at 2x scale producing a very large PDF (~21 MB); consider lower up-scaling or JPEG compression for the embedded PNG to reduce filesize significantly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead d0df5baa still has 3 structures: House (with edges → no badge), Attached Garage (3 planes, 0 edges → badge shown), Front Covered Porch (1 plane → no badge). Snap guide appears reliably during slow drag; PDF is multi-page with title block.
